stop_condition: Stop before the next cell if cumulative actual cost would exceed the p2-derived forecast envelope ($0.051468 for 3 cells) or the campaign stop budget ($20). A stopped cell is recorded as not-run, never silently omitted.
selection_note: All four listed candidates were ineligible (no kind:test; plus non-repeatable/destructive/no-symbol-change). The p2 candidate manifest selected the bespoke calibration cell (c5), which is repeatable. p3 runs two more independent trials of the bespoke cell: one multiply (the p2 feature, re-run fresh) and one divide (a variant spec with a divide-by-zero guard, so the realized outcome is a genuine measurement).
